title: Lions ink All-Pro LB Campbell to 4-year extension

sources.name: ESPN NFL
sources.title: Lions ink All-Pro LB Campbell to 4-year extension
sources.description: The Lions have signed Jack Campbell to a four-year extension, putting him under contract with the franchise through the 2030 season. The deal is for $81 million and includes $51.5M guaranteed, sources told NFL Network's Ian Rapoport.
